# Virtual Tracker

Virtual Tracker is a workforce productivity and time-tracking platform for modern teams. It helps organizations capture work accurately, improve visibility, manage projects, and streamline billing and reporting.

## Core value
- Precise time tracking for remote, hybrid, and field teams
- Project and task-level visibility
- Payroll, invoicing, and reporting workflows
